about_the_game:
Live and conquer in love like a ladies' man, or maybe not, guided by a seducer.

Tune up your vehicle, warm up your engine, and hit the gas... Take home a beautiful trophy and do the victory dance in front of others, with the most thrilling races in history.

Survive the war and forge your own trauma, or be a full-on gangster and shoot up the cops, with relentless realism, guided by an expert gunslinger.

Survive the horror, earn your extreme panic survivor badge, and don't open that door... boo!!.

Master martial arts and hand-to-hand combat, block, dodge, punch, strike, kick, fall, and sleep. Panther, Karate, Taekwondo, Boxing, Kung Fu, MMA, Muay Thai, Krav Maga, Capoeira, Wrestling, Street Fighting, Slashes, Swords, Axes, Maces, Bows, Crossbows, Shields, Spears, Knives, Sticks, Electric Weapons, and more, guided by an expert martial artist.

Forge your trading empire, hire sugarbabies, and prove your power without breaking the bank, or driving the competition to ruin, with the most lucrative business worlds.

Master your body and mind, hit the gym hard, and build that amazing body you’ve been dreaming of that attracts girls, but don’t forget to make money to keep your jewelry in place.

Bulletproof invites you to travel, to explore its 250 worlds, 50 game modes, 7 versions, and 6 types of art (in its Gold Master version). (Note: Approximately 70-80% is operational)

Endless Runner, Shooter, Platform, Narrative, Arcade, MMORPG, Strategy, Battle Royale, Turn-based, Cooperative or Competitive Multiplayer. Play your way... with your rules...

The genres of the worlds range from horror, military, social, racing, sports, fantasy, science fiction, survival, hobbies, animals, lucrative, festive, toys, and children's themes, and more. (Age Rating by Parental Control: +7 - +17)

Gameplay Description: Its gameplay consists of open worlds and advanced mechanics (with a progressive system), without limitations on the player's actions, meaning one can interact, attack with different types of weapons or without them, ride vehicles or horses (depending on the world), can provoke police chases or local authority pursuits, and with complex objectives in some modes allowing for an innovative experience such as planning a bank robbery step by step.

Shootouts, Fights, and Realistic Driving, Intelligent RTS, Dynamic Worlds, Spectacular Turn-Based Mode, Infinite Levels (in some modes), Missions and Stories created at our whim (meaning they can be expanded over time), and Evolving AI.

The history of humanity and fiction at your feet:

World of Dinosaurs (In Development), World of Primates (In Development), Stone Age, Ancient Egypt, Ancient Rome/Greece, Dascar Racing, Formula 1 Racing, Death Races, Viking Age, Medieval Age, The Dynasty, American Civil War, American War of Independence, World War I, World War II, World War III, Discovery of America, Russian War, Vietnam War (In Development), Afghanistan War, 21st Century, 24th Century, 27th Century...

Coming soon

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2,90GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3,5GHz

  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1650 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Additional Notes: Requirements may vary depending on game art

short_description: Change the art, change the history, change the rules of the game and let your imagination soar with the 250 Worlds and 50 Modes of Bulletproof... (Shooter, RTS, MMORPG, Arcade, Martial arts, Sports, Horror, Racing, War... There is no limit to fun)
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal
